gh-3ug2.title: Google car: roof rack, black tape
gh-3ug2.summary: A roof rack with a piece of black tape on the right end of the front bar. The hood is usually visible with a car wrap showing a red rectangle. This car alone usually tells you the country.

gh-4Awi.title: Road: very new asphalt, centre line only
gh-4Awi.summary: Dark, spotless asphalt with a crisp middle line and no outer lines, with dense vegetation and some palms. This is the N1 near Elubo, up to Azuleti, where the middle line disappears.

gh-4IA8.title: Landscape: flat, red soil, tropical plants
gh-4IA8.summary: Mostly flat land with red soil and lots of tropical vegetation, with palms especially in the south. Some regions have hills or mountains.

gh-74In.title: Landscape: unpaved roads in dry savannah
gh-74In.summary: Most dirt roads in dry savannah are north of the town of Wa, and near it. Other dirt roads in the north are in the east and on a dark-soiled road near Salaga.

gh-7ooz.title: Vegetation: dense forest with natural palms
gh-7ooz.summary: Thick forest with many wild palm trees points to the southwest or the east.

gh-EktN.title: Taxis: multicoloured body panels
gh-EktN.summary: Taxis have mixed-colour bodies, and the fenders and rear side panels are always orange-yellow.

gh-Grzs.title: Google car: Gen 4 near the two big cities
gh-Grzs.summary: Most of the newer Gen 4 coverage is close to Accra or Kumasi, with only a few major roads covered.

gh-H3ol.title: Google car: three kinds of front tape
gh-H3ol.summary: Three tape looks: mostly intact tape in the southwest, slightly peeled tape in the east and north, and tape with two white spots on the left north of Kumasi and west of Tamale.

gh-H4D5.title: Vegetation: tall coastal palms
gh-H4D5.summary: Tall palm trees line the coast, mostly in the west.

gh-JppT.title: Landscape: dry savannah
gh-JppT.summary: Dry soil and sparse vegetation point to the savannah in the north.

gh-Kg6Q.title: Roads: map of paved and unpaved roads
gh-Kg6Q.summary: A map showing which roads are paved and which are unpaved across the country. Use it to place a dirt road.

gh-KrKW.title: Coverage: overcast dirt road
gh-KrKW.summary: A dirt road in dark, moody overcast shots with very dark purple or brown soil and a tropical savannah feel. The soil is darkest near the town of Salaga.

gh-Tx1K.title: Road lines: always white
gh-Tx1K.summary: Road lines are always white, never yellow. Many paved roads have no lines at all.

gh-VFa6.title: Landscape: tall mountain ranges near the lake
gh-VFa6.summary: Tall mountain ranges are seen near Lake Volta in the highlighted area. Ranges in the east are more common near the border with Togo.

gh-Y6Tn.title: Google car: white car and mirrors in reserves
gh-Y6Tn.summary: In several nature reserves you see a white car with side mirrors instead of the usual car. The same black tape is still there.

gh-Yl0l.title: Landscape: lagoon beside a sandy coastal road
gh-Yl0l.summary: A road running along a lagoon, most visible in the northern part, with sandy soil, a coastal feel and sometimes grey rocks by the roadside. This is the Keta Lagoon in the southeast.

gh-bJXr.title: Google car: grey or white pickup, front antenna
gh-bJXr.summary: The newer Gen 4 coverage uses a grey or white pickup truck with an antenna at the front. The truck is usually blurred, fully or partly.

gh-c7W9.title: Road: unpaved, powerline to the east
gh-c7W9.summary: An unpaved road running south-east to north-west in lush savannah with a powerline close to your east or northeast. City roads can have powerlines on both sides.

gh-dAJp.title: Plate: white normal, yellow commercial
gh-dAJp.summary: Normal cars have white plates and commercial vehicles have yellow ones, long or short. You often see a mix. Nigeria's white plates have a green tint.

differs.how: White plates with a visible green tint

gh-hLru.title: Coverage: limited, main roads and big cities
gh-hLru.summary: Coverage is limited to main roads and major cities. It is densest in the south, around the two biggest cities, Accra and Kumasi.

gh-hyou.title: Google car: whole front visible
gh-hyou.summary: The whole front of the car can be seen, with only the camera blurred, plus a street view vinyl on the roof and the usual tape. This is the Ankasa Game Reserve.

gh-lK0K.title: Road lines: crisp new lines on an east-west road
gh-lK0K.summary: A road with very crisp new lines, running roughly east-west through lush savannah. The middle line can be solid or dashed. Other crisp roads have a different angle or landscape.

gh-lm-394486.title: Phone numbers: 03X, third digit shows the region
gh-lm-394486.summary: Numbers look like 03X XXX XXXX, where the third digit rises from south (0) to north (9). Other prefixes like 02 or 05 are mobiles or older numbers.

gh-m5GG.title: Pole: wooden with 3 insulators on metal crossbar
gh-m5GG.summary: Wooden poles with three insulators sitting on a metal crossbar. Kenya has a similar pole.

gh-nHMr.title: Google car: only a black right mirror shows
gh-nHMr.summary: No tape or roof rack is visible, just a black right-hand mirror slightly outside the blur. This is the Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary. Red soil and vegetation still help.

gh-sHFU.title: Signposts: black and white stripes in cities
gh-sHFU.summary: Black and white striped signposts are mostly in cities, while rural roads have plain unpainted metal posts. Other countries have striped posts too, so check other clues.

gh-trbc.title: Paint: red, yellow, green and black star
gh-trbc.summary: Things are often painted in the national flag colours: red, yellow and green, sometimes with a black star.

gh-yRvT.title: Landscape: flat, wide open coast, little green
gh-yRvT.summary: A very flat, wide open coastal area with less vegetation than the rest of the south, sometimes dry-looking. This is just east of Accra, especially on the N1.

gh-zy0V.title: Road: grey overcast, ridgeline to the southeast
gh-zy0V.summary: A road running south-west to north-east under a very grey, overcast sky, with a ridgeline fairly close to your southeast. This is on the N2, east of Lake Volta.
